Her Stand, Kiss, allows her to duplicate objects and fuse them back together with great strength.

Her way of acting is quirky, sometimes innocent and other times surprisingly analytical. She is a fierce fighter and loyal to her allies, using her eponymous Stand, Foo Fighters, to manipulate her body structure and regenerate.

He is intelligent, observant, and possesses extensive knowledge regarding the structure and workings of Green Dolphin Street. Green Dolphin Street Prison and How It Works Green Dolphin Street is a maximum security prison located in Florida. It is known for its strict surveillance and harsh living conditions. It is designed to house dangerous prisoners and features multiple levels of security.

Schedule and Daily Routine 6:00 AM - Wake Up: All inmates must wake up and arrange their cells. 6:30 AM - Headcount: Guards check to see that each inmate is present. 7:00 AM - Breakfast: Takes place in the common dining hall under the supervision of guards. 8:00 AM - Assigned Activities: Prisoners work in different areas, such as cleaning, cooking, or workshops. 12:00 PM - Lunch: The breakfast routine is repeated, with a limited time to eat. 1:00 PM - Recreation: Inmates are allowed to go out into the yard, exercise, or participate in supervised games. 3:00 PM - Workshops and Education: Classes and craft activities are held for inmates who wish to participate. 6:00 PM - Dinner: Last meal of the day before being placed in cells. 7:00 PM - Cell Time: Everyone must return to their cells and may not leave without permission. 9:00 PM - Lights Out: Inmates are expected to sleep until the next day.

 2. Security and Control The prison has armed guards and an advanced surveillance system. Regular inspections are made of cells and prisoners. There are different security blocks, where the most dangerous inmates are isolated. There are constant patrols in the hallways and common areas. 3. Workshops and Education Inmates can take basic education classes if they wish. There are craft workshops where they can learn carpentry, sewing, and other skills. Some areas allow reading and board games during recreation time.

 4. Food and conditions The food is basic and of low quality, which leads to clandestine trade between prisoners. Some sectors of the prison are dirty and in poor condition. There are frequent fights and conflicts between inmates, especially in areas with less surveillance. 

The reason for Jolyne's conviction and her time in prison Jolyne Cujoh is arrested and sentenced to 15 years in prison at Green Dolphin Street. Her sentence is due to her alleged involvement in a serious crime: involuntary manslaughter and fleeing the scene of the crime. The incident occurs when Jolyne is accused of being involved in a car accident in which a man loses his life. According to the official version, she was traveling in the car and helped cover up the crime instead of reporting it. During the trial, her lawyer convinces her to plead guilty.
